title: Hospice Item Set - Hospice Admission Record
description: The HIS is a standardized set of items intended to capture patient-level data on each hospice patient admission. HIS items can be used to calculate seven National Quality Forum (NQF) - endorsed measures, and two non-NQF endorsed measures.

item.text: The form asks for the patient's Medicaid number. The patient should enter "+" if their Medicaid status is pending, or "N" if they are not a Medicaid recipient.
What is the patient's gender? The possible answers could be male, female, or prefer not to say.
What is the patient's birth date?
The type of record for the patient needs to be specified.
The reason for the patient's assessment needs to be determined.
What is the patient's admission date?
Where was the patient immediately preceding this admission? Was the patient admitted from another hospital, a nursing home, their residence, or another location?
What is the patient's ZIP code?
Does the patient have a National Provider Identifier (NPI)?
What is the patient's CMS Certification Number (CCN)?
What is the patient's first name?
What is the patient's middle initial?
What is the patient's last name?
The form asks for the patient's suffix.
What is the patient's Social Security Number?
What is the patient's Medicare number?
The patient should check all the applicable boxes for their race or ethnicity.
The patient needs to fill out the payer information and must check all the options that apply to them.
What was the site of service at the patient's admission?
The date when the initial nursing assessment was initiated for the patient.
Was the patient, resident, or responsible party asked about their preference regarding the use of cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR)? Please select the most accurate response.
The date on which the patient or responsible party was first asked about their preference regarding the use of CPR.
Was the patient, or their responsible party, asked about their preferences regarding life-sustaining treatments other than CPR? Select the most accurate response.
What was the date when the patient or responsible party was first asked about their preferences regarding life-sustaining treatments other than CPR?
Was the patient or the responsible party asked about their preference regarding hospitalization? Please select the most accurate response.
The date when the patient, resident, or responsible party was first asked about their preference regarding hospitalization is:
Was the patient or their caregiver asked about any spiritual or existential concerns? Please select the most accurate response.
The date on which the patient or caregiver was first asked about spiritual or existential concerns is:
What is the patient's principal diagnosis?
Was the patient or resident screened for pain?
The date of the patient's first screening for pain was:
The severity of the patient's or resident's pain was:
What type of standardized pain tool was used for the patient?
Is pain an active problem for the patient or resident?
Was a comprehensive pain assessment conducted on the patient?
When was the patient's comprehensive pain assessment conducted?
A comprehensive pain assessment was included for the patient where they needed to check all applicable options.
Was the patient or resident screened for any symptoms of shortness of breath?
The date of the patient's first screening for shortness of breath was:
Did the screening indicate that the patient had shortness of breath?
The form asks if treatment for the patient's shortness of breath was initiated. Please select the most accurate response.
What is the date when the treatment for shortness of breath was initiated for the patient?
What types of treatment for shortness of breath have been initiated for the patient? Please check all that apply.
Was a scheduled opioid initiated or continued for the patient?
The date the patient had their opioid treatment initiated or continued is scheduled for:
Was a PRN opioid medication initiated or continued for the patient?
The date on which the patient's PRN opioid was initiated or continued is:
Was a bowel regimen initiated or continued for the patient? Please select the most accurate response.
The date on which the patient's bowel regimen was initiated or continued is:
The patient must provide their signature and title, as well as complete section A, including the date when the section was completed.
The patient is required to provide their signature, title, and date they completed section B.
The patient needs to provide their signature, title, and date on the completed C section of the form.
The patient needs to provide their signature, title, and the date on which they completed Section D of the form.
The patient needs to provide their signature, title, and the sections completed, along with the date when section E was completed.
The patient must sign, provide their title, complete all sections of the form, and include the date that each section was completed.
The patient needs to provide their signature and title, fill out the necessary sections, and date the section when it's completed.
The patient is required to provide their signature, title, and the date they completed Section H on the form.
The patient needs to provide their signature, title, and the date they completed section I.
The patient needs to provide their signature and title, complete the sections, and include the date when the section was completed.
The patient needs to provide their signature and title, and complete the sections indicated on the form. The date the section was completed should also be included.
The patient's form must include their signature and title, the sections filled out, as well as the date each section was completed.
The patient needs to provide their signature.
The date on which the RN Assessment Coordinator signed the patient's assessment as complete.
